tasks.spec:
You are a reconciliation worker. Two independent builders implemented the same spec - a validator and a graph generator - and the validator rejects the graph with 65 of 185 assertion failures. The SPEC IS THE JUDGE. OFFLINE: no network, no git, no MCP, no skills; write only in your working directory.

THE SPEC (authoritative): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workV94d4/amend-reference-point/SPEC-v94-draft4.md
VALIDATOR (copy to ./check_goalloop_graph.py, then amend your copy): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGL/gl-validator-builder/check_goalloop_graph.py - its six fixture proofs are LOCKED: the incident gates (no fail-stay anywhere, no mid-negotiation terminals, semantic promise ban, clock containment outside offer nodes, single extraction definition) may not be weakened under any adjudication. Copy its fixtures too and keep them passing/failing exactly as before.
GRAPH GENERATOR (copy to ./build_goalloop.py and ./pathway-goalloop-draft.json, then amend your copies): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGL/gl-graph-builder/

METHOD: run the validator against the graph; for EACH failure adjudicate with a spec citation: (a) GRAPH DEFECT - the spec supports the assertion, fix build_goalloop.py; (b) VALIDATOR OVER-REACH - the assertion checks something the spec does not place in the static graph (example already known: it asserts latency measurements and a p95 report on a static graph - latency belongs to the harness plan, not graph shape; convert such assertions to harness-plan notes or delete them, citing the spec section); (c) SPEC AMBIGUITY - both readings defensible: choose the safer-for-patients reading, implement consistently in BOTH artifacts, and mark AMBIGUOUS in the table. Iterate regenerating the graph until the validator prints PASS. Then re-run all six fixtures and confirm unchanged behavior.

WRITE ./RECONCILIATION.md: a table of every original failure - assertion, verdict (GRAPH-DEFECT | VALIDATOR-OVER-REACH | AMBIGUOUS), spec citation, what changed. End with 'RECONCILED: graph passes N assertions; fixtures green=1 red=5; gates preserved'.

VERIFY before finishing: validator passes the final graph; fixture-conformant passes; all five tamper fixtures still rejected; zero banned phrases in the graph; node count within spec bounds. Final message <=12 lines.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile check_goalloop_graph.py build_goalloop.py || exit 1; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 check_goalloop_graph.py --draft pathway-goalloop-draft.json > final.txt 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: validator still rejects the graph:'; grep -E '^FAIL' final.txt | head -5; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'PASS' final.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no PASS line'; exit 1; }; g=0; r=0; for f in fixture-conformant fixture-A-wait-self-loop fixture-B-negotiation-terminal fixture-C-banned-promise fixture-D-clock-containment fixture-E-duplicate-extraction; do if PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 check_goalloop_graph.py --draft $f.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ "$f" = fixture-conformant ] && g=1 || { echo "FAIL: tamper fixture $f now passes - a gate was weakened"; exit 1; }; else [ "$f" = fixture-conformant ] && { echo 'FAIL: conformant fixture rejected'; exit 1; } || r=$((r+1)); fi; done; [ "$g" -eq 1 ] && [ "$r" -eq 5 ] || { echo "FAIL: fixture outcomes g=$g r=$r"; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'RECONCILED:' RECONCILIATION.md || { echo 'FAIL: no reconciliation summary'; exit 1; }; n=$(grep -cE 'GRAPH-DEFECT|VALIDATOR-OVER-REACH|AMBIGUOUS' RECONCILIATION.md); [ "$n" -ge 20 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n adjudications for 65 failures"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: graph validator-green; all six fixture gates preserved; $n adjudications on record"
tasks.verified: The validator and graph reconciled with the spec as judge: every divergence adjudicated with citations, the graph now validator-green, and all six incident-gate fixtures re-proven unweakened.
